champion.tips: MASTER YI TIPS AND TRICKS When laning against ranged champions, try and limit how much chip damage you take from them via auto-attacks. Use your Q to dodge incoming skill shots and CC by enemy laners. You can also use your Q to dodge tower shots as well. Keeping the wave closer to your side of the lane in the very early game will allow you to pick up farm and potentially all-in the enemy. If you’re constantly pushing, you will find it hard to all-in an enemy.
champion.builds: THE BEST MASTER YI BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR MID IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Master Yi Mid build, you should take Flash and Ignite as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Lethal Tempo as your keystone, followed by Triumph, Legend: Alacrity and Coup de Grace in the primary tree, as well as Sudden Impact and Ultimate Hunter in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Attack Speed in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Blade of The Ruined King as your first item, followed by Berserker's Greaves and Guinsoo's Rageblade. For your last 3 items, you should build Wit's End, Kraken Slayer and finish with Guardian Angel. For the skill order, you want to stick with Q - E - W. Right now, this build has 48.6% winrate over 109 matches played. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Ignite as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Hail of Blades as your keystone, Sudden Impact, Grisly Mementos and Treasure Hunter in the primary tree, and Legend: Alacrity with Triumph in the secondary tree, as well as Attack Speed, Adaptive Force, and Health Scaling as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Blade of The Ruined King as your first item, then Berserker's Greaves as a second item and Guinsoo's Rageblade as a third item. You want to finish the build with Kraken Slayer, Death's Dance and Sundered Sky. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it Q - E - W. This build is currently sitting at a 40.4% win rate across 99 matches played. Off-Meta If you want to try an Off-Meta Master Yi Mid build in the current patch, try Flash and Ignite as your Summoner Spells, Hail of Blades, Sudden Impact, Grisly Mementos and Treasure Hunter as your primary rune tree, and Legend: Alacrity with Triumph as your secondary tree. Use Attack Speed, Adaptive Force and Health Scaling as your shards. For items in this build, you want to complete Kraken Slayer as your first item, then finish Berserker's Greaves as your second item, and Guinsoo's Rageblade as third item. The last 3 options are Blade of The Ruined King, Death's Dance and Titanic Hydra. The ability order for this build is Q - E - W. As of the current patch, this build has a 51.9% win rate over 81 matches played. Situational Master Yi Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Master Yi build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Master Yi runes page.
